entries.title: Ephesians 5:1
segments: Be ye therefore imitators of God, as beloved children;

entries.title: Ephesians 5:2
segments: and walk in love, even as Christ also loved you, and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for an odor of a sweet smell.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:3
segments: But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not even be named among you, as becometh saints;

entries.title: Ephesians 5:4
segments: nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, or jesting, which are not befitting: but rather giving of thanks.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:5
segments: For this ye know of a surety, that no fornicator, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and God.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:6
segments: Let no man deceive you with empty words: for because of these things cometh the wrath of God upon the sons of disobedience.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:7
segments: Be not ye therefore partakers with them;

entries.title: Ephesians 5:8
segments: For ye were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord: walk as children of light

entries.title: Ephesians 5:9
segments: (for the fruit of the light is in all goodness and righteousness and truth),

entries.title: Ephesians 5:10
segments: proving what is well-pleasing unto the Lord;

entries.title: Ephesians 5:11
segments: and have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather even reprove them;

entries.title: Ephesians 5:12
segments: for the things which are done by them in secret it is a shame even to speak of.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:13
segments: But all things when they are reproved are made manifest by the light: for everything that is made manifest is light.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:14
segments: Wherefore [he] saith, Awake, thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall shine upon thee.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:15
segments: Look therefore carefully how ye walk, not as unwise, but as wise;

entries.title: Ephesians 5:16
segments: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:17
segments: Wherefore be ye not foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:18
segments: And be not drunken with wine, wherein is riot, but be filled with the Spirit;

entries.title: Ephesians 5:19
segments: speaking one to another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody with your heart to the Lord;

entries.title: Ephesians 5:20
segments: giving thanks always for all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to God, even the Father;

entries.title: Ephesians 5:21
segments: subjecting yourselves one to another in the fear of Christ.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:22
segments: Wives, [be in subjection] unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:23
segments: For the husband is the head of the wife, and Christ also is the head of the church, [being] himself the saviour of the body.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:24
segments: But as the church is subject to Christ, so [let] the wives also [be] to their husbands in everything.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:25
segments: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself up for it;

entries.title: Ephesians 5:26
segments: that he might sanctify it, having cleansed it by the washing of water with the word,

entries.title: Ephesians 5:27
segments: that he might present the church to himself a glorious [church], not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:28
segments: Even so ought husbands also to love their own wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his own wife loveth himself:

entries.title: Ephesians 5:29
segments: for no man ever hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as Christ also the church;

entries.title: Ephesians 5:30
segments: because we are members of his body.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:31
segments: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife; and the two shall become one flesh.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:32
segments: This mystery is great: but I speak in regard of Christ and of the church.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:33
segments: Nevertheless do ye also severally love each one his own wife even as himself; and [let] the wife [see] that she fear her husband.
